svg.title: CaseVera — Ai Investigation Agent
svg.desc: CaseVera: Policy-constrained agent that investigates fraud alerts end to end — retrieval over past cases and policy, evidence with provenance, SAR narratives — with deterministic verdicts. 2 / 2 fraud patterns; 20 / 20 cases persisted; 273 evidence records. Recognition: Top 25 · Hacker House Goa. Tech: Python, GraphRAG, Vector search, TigerGraph, React.
